description: A growing number of frontier AI researchers, unsettled by the collapse in safety and control, begin relocating to jurisdictions with strong legal protections for scientific autonomy and public-sector research mandates. A visible cohort moves to EU member states offering protected academic status and independent evaluation roles, bringing tacit knowledge and raising the baseline of domestic capability. This migration is not state-organized but is enabled by the EU's activation of the Emergency Response Corps and its public stance on safety.
